name: Dirty Pipe
summary: Unprivileged overwrite of read-only files via pipe buffer flags bug; reliable LPE on Linux 5.8+.

name: DirtyCow
summary: Race in mm copy-on-write allowing write to read-only mappings; iconic kernel LPE.

name: Meltdown
summary: Transient execution allowing user code to read kernel memory; drove KPTI.
related_papers: Meltdown: Reading Kernel Memory from User Space

name: Spectre
summary: Branch/speculation gadgets leaking memory across privilege boundaries including kernel.

name: Netfilter xt_tables heap (nft_verdict)
summary: Heap OOB write in Netfilter enabling LPE; widely used in kernelCTF/pwn.

name: n_gsm LDISC use-after-free
summary: GSM multiplexing line-discipline UAF leading to LPE; exploited in the wild.

name: io_uring privilege issues (class)
summary: Multiple io_uring bugs enabling LPE; frequent syzbot/kernelCTF target surface.

name: af_packet / TPACKET races (class)
summary: Classic packet socket heap exploit path used in many teaching materials.

name: OverlayFS / shiftfs style LPEs (class)
summary: Filesystem uid-mapping / overlay bugs repeatedly yielding container escapes/LPE.

name: eBPF verifier bugs (class)
summary: Verifier logic bugs allow attacker-controlled eBPF to achieve arbitrary RW / LPE.

name: KASAN-discovered UAF floods (syzbot class)
summary: Ongoing class of use-after-free/OOB bugs found by syzbot+KASAN across drivers/net/fs.

name: Dirty Cred / file credential reuse class
summary: Exploits abusing struct file / cred lifetime for LPE; popular in research writeups.
